authors: Anna S. C. Tirion; Danielle D'Lima; Julia Terlet; Ramya Rao; Leslie M. Gutman

summary: A systematic review of 26 interventions across 19 articles that tried to shift eaters toward sustainable food choices in supermarkets, restaurants, and cafeterias. The authors coded the interventions with the Behaviour Change Technique Taxonomy and found 13 techniques in use. Restructuring the physical environment, such as changing menu defaults or product placement, appeared in the most effective interventions.
